items.title: Britain won't tolerate threats on our soil, Miliband says as he summons Iran ambassador
items.summary: The prime minister says Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard "almost certainly" directed the RAF Fairford incident.

items.title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
items.summary: Despite the US president announcing energy infrastructure would not be targeted strikes have continued, Ukraine says.

items.title: Watch: What could Trump's energy ceasefire mean for Ukraine?
items.summary: The BBC's Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv, where Ukrainians face another winter with electricity outages.

items.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
items.summary: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

items.title: On Yemen's desert battlefield, a war with global consequences is being waged
items.summary: Yemen's entrenched civil war is now impossible to ignore. But in operating rooms in its port city of Aden, geopolitics feels remote.

items.title: Immigration agents search Democratic congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home
items.summary: Omar, an outspoken Trump critic, said the search was "an attempt to target political enemies" and that she "will not be silenced".

items.title: Deloitte helped in falsifying documents to evade tax on Abramovich’s wealth, BBC finds
items.summary: Backdated paperwork also made the Russian oligarch’s yachts and mansions disappear from accounts, investigation finds.

items.title: French supermarket fridges heated to 50C in 'unprecedented' cyber attack
items.summary: Hundreds of stores were targeted by the overnight hack, which spoiled fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros.
